title: Laguna Lake Residences Aster
location: Laguna Phuket, Bang Tao / Cherng Talay
shortDescription: Laguna Lake Residences Aster is a lakeside condominium by Laguna Property, the development arm of Banyan Group, inside the Laguna Phuket resort community.
description: Laguna Lake Residences Aster is a lakeside condominium by Laguna Property, the development arm of Banyan Group, inside the Laguna Phuket resort community. It offers 1- to 3-bedroom units of about 56 to 113 sqm, with a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the lake. The project is a short walk from the Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket dining and retail area.
facilities: 60 m rooftop infinity pool overlooking the lake
